process: PlastPyro 40,000 t/y mixed plastic waste pyrolysis plant, Belgium (Sect. 2-4, Tables 1, 4, 5)
value: PlastPyro: mixed plastic waste fed onto molten zinc held at 450-500 degC in a direct-contact pyrolysis chamber; vapours and floating carbon-rich ash are extracted, separated in a cyclone and the vapours condensed to pyrolysis oil; non-condensable gas fires the burners, making the process self-sustaining.
